crs.note: OpenStreetMap lon/lat is transformed from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:2955 with easting/northing axis order, the same horizontal step as the terrain export. Y is metres above originElevation and is present only when a terrain height grid can be sampled. OSM ele tags are copied onto peaks and are not used as Y.

heights.note: Sampled Y uses the terrain grid's CGVD2013 heights, converted into the export vertical origin at 1600.0 m.
